cuerpo: Vessel spent over 260 consecutive days at sea without a port call, a US navy record Sign up for the US Breaking News email Donald Trump has said he wants to develop one of his Florida golf courses into a presidential retreat where his successors can spend quiet weekends on the greens, describing it as “sort of a Camp David ” that he says would already have many of the security features needed to host presidents and world leaders. The proposal for the retreat on Trump’s private golf course in West Palm Beach would comingle the presidency with Trump’s business ventures beyond his time in office, and is the latest example of Trump seeking ways to leave his imprint on the presidency.
